major_concerns: Simulator realism and SLO/traffic assumptions are underspecified (threat to external validity).
Rollback-cost and MTTR estimands rely on strong, site-specific assumptions.
Risk of overfitting predictive models to simulated scenarios and limited topology diversity.
Potential lack of multi-vendor realism in configuration corpus.
required_design_repairs: Specify simulator modeling assumptions and justify SLO/failure models; provide sensitivity ranges for key simulator parameters.
Include multi-vendor config samples or explicit synthesis procedure and provenance for all config artifacts.
Add explicit regularization and external-validation plan (e.g., holdout topologies) and publish all artifacts/hashes and tool versions for reproducibility.

major_concerns: Contamination-detection heuristics risk false positives/negatives; provenance inferences are probabilistic.
Limited access to authoritative training-corpus manifests constrains claims about contamination source.
Potential reputational/legal sensitivity when reporting dataset maintainers' artifacts.
required_design_repairs: Define and justify detection thresholds and provide estimated FP/FN rates with a manual spot-check protocol.
Include a clear, conservative responsible-disclosure policy and redact sensitive provenance evidence where appropriate.
Provide explicit list of datasets evaluated, seeds, and reproducible scripts to re-run contamination checks; publish sampled manual annotations used for heuristic validation.

major_concerns: High risk of producing actionable adversarial guidance; ethical and disclosure concerns are prominent.
Adversarial scenarios and multi-agent interactions may be unrealistic without modeling human operator mitigation.
Attribution of failure modes to specific components may be confounded by complex interactions.
required_design_repairs: Add an explicit ethical review / responsible-disclosure plan and redact exploitable details in artifacts.
Preregister adversary generation heuristics with bounded budgets and conservative realism constraints; include human-operator mitigation models or clearly bound external validity.

Strengthen analysis plan to include ablations and causal attribution methods (e.g., disabling components, counterfactual runs) and publish sanitized transcripts and verification logs for reproducibility.

major_concerns: Potential inclusion of sensitive vendor templates; legal/sensitivity risk if provenance not carefully controlled.
Oracle semantics (what verifier guarantees) need precise specification to avoid ambiguous evaluation.
Long-term maintenance and hosting of benchmark artifacts not specified, threatening reproducibility.
required_design_repairs: Constrain corpora to public or fully synthesized templates and document synthesis/provenance procedure; add redaction rules.
Define verifier input/output contracts and clearly enumerate properties checked (reachability, isolation, etc.) and tool versions used.
Provide a reproducibility and hosting plan (artifact hashes, persistent storage links or containerized runners) and a minimal reference implementation for baseline methods.
